## Seo Analyzer

Seo Analyzer is an online tool, available at https://seoanalyzer.me/, that checks websites for SEO problems. The interface offers a language option (currently EN). There are two main pages: Home (https://seoanalyzer.me/) and Site vs Site (https://seoanalyzer.me/site-vs-site).

## Core message

- Tagline: get an instant analysis of your SEO problems.
- Supporting line: the tool pinpoints SEO errors and helps you improve your site's content for better optimization.
- A "Review" label appears alongside example analysed sites.

## Example analysed sites

- H-supertools: https://seoanalyzer.me/domain/h-supertools.com
- Booksandmore: https://seoanalyzer.me/domain/booksandmore.blog
- L-ink: https://seoanalyzer.me/domain/L-ink.me

## Features

- **Unlimited Analysis:** Run as many analyses as you want, processed on the service's most powerful servers. Saved reports let you look back at progress and earlier work.
- **In-Depth Reviews:** Detailed website analysis that explains how to fix SEO issues, with a plain definition for every SEO metric.
- **Competitive Analysis:** Compare your site's SEO side by side with competitors to see where you can improve against them.

I built the site as a single page, `index.html`, in your project folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

- **Sections:** Home has the tagline and the three example-site links, with a "Review" label. Below that are the three features, the six recently listed sites with a "View More" link, About us, Contact and the footer.
- **Recent sites:** each card shows its score out of 100, global rank and page speed. Portal.oouagoiwoye.edu.ng has no image in `images/`, so it gets a "No preview" placeholder.
- **Links:** the "Site vs Site" nav link and button point to the live page at https://seoanalyzer.me/site-vs-site, because the brief had no content for that page. The site-name links go to their pages on seoanalyzer.me.
- **Social icons:** the footer shows four placeholder icons, since the brief gave no destinations.
- **Theme:** the page follows the viewer's light or dark setting and works at phone width.
- **Images:** the originals in `images/` had no file extension, so I copied each one as `.jpg` and the page uses the copies. The originals are untouched.
